title: 伊斯兰继承推理共享任务QIAS 2026综述
summary: 本文介绍了QIAS 2026共享任务，旨在评估大语言模型在伊斯兰继承法领域的复杂推理能力。任务基于MAWARITH基准数据集（12500个阿拉伯语继承案例），要求系统完成从自然语言案例到最终份额分配的端到端推理。16个团队参与了任务，探索了提示工程、检索增强生成和微调等方法。结果表明，伊斯兰继承推理对当前语言模型仍极具挑战性。
summary_en: This paper presents the QIAS 2026 shared task evaluating LLMs on complex reasoning in Islamic inheritance law. Based on the MAWARITH benchmark (12,500 Arabic cases), it requires end-to-end reasoning from natural language to final share distribution. 16 teams explored prompting, RAG, and fine-tuning. Results show Islamic inheritance reasoning remains highly challenging for current models.
